title: Backwater through a chain of manholes
description: Twenty 1.2 m pipes (50 m each, n = 0.013, slope 0.001) carry 0.6 m³/s from normal depth (0.59 m) down to an outfall held 1.0 m above its invert. The M1 backwater profile through the manholes is integrated from the outfall to 1e-11 (gradually varied flow in the exact circular section).

citations.title: Storm Water Management Model Reference Manual Volume II – Hydraulics (EPA/600/R-17/111)

criteria.rationale: Worst manhole or pipe depth within 2 cm. A link–node model represents each 50 m pipe by its end heads and a mid-pipe depth, a second-order discretisation of the profile whose error here is a few millimetres; the rest is the section tables.
Pipe flows within 0.5 % of the inflow.

convergence.not_applicable: A link–node network with a closed-form (or 1e-11 integrated) reference at fixed elements: there is no grid to refine.
